text: The future of artificial intelligence is exciting and uncertain. Today we have "narrow AI", which is good at one task, like translating languages. However, many researchers are working on "general AI" (AGI), a system that can think and learn like a human. AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving problems in medicine and science. But there are also serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI will arrive. Some say it is decades away, while others believe it could happen much sooner. Either way, we need to discuss how to develop AI safely and fairly.
